name: Information Request
definition: Requests for general information about COVID-19, including symptoms, transmission, and treatments.

name: Travel Concerns
definition: Inquiries about travel safety, restrictions, and guidelines related to COVID-19.

name: Safety Precautions
definition: Questions and advice on how to stay safe and prevent the spread of COVID-19.

name: Myths and Misinformation
definition: Requests for clarification on myths, misconceptions, and false information regarding COVID-19.

name: Health and Symptoms
definition: Inquiries about symptoms of COVID-19 and health-related concerns.

name: Donations and Support
definition: Requests for information on how to donate or support COVID-19 relief efforts.

name: Updates and News
definition: Requests for the latest news, statistics, and updates on COVID-19.

name: Animal Concerns
definition: Questions regarding the impact of COVID-19 on pets and other animals.

name: Treatment Options
definition: Inquiries about available treatments and medications for COVID-19.

name: Community Impact
definition: Questions about the effects of COVID-19 on local communities and economies.

name: Personal Experiences
definition: Requests for sharing personal experiences or stories related to COVID-19.

name: Government and Policy
definition: Inquiries about government responses, policies, and regulations related to COVID-19.
